bullets.text: In Chennai, heavy overnight rain caused severe waterlogging in residential areas, including the Velachery toll booth bus station, disrupting normal life.
The bodies of two 14-year-old schoolboys who drowned in Puzhal Lake near Murugambedu were recovered by authorities, highlighting local safety risks.
In Velachery, police arrested an electrician who allegedly entered a women's hostel room and sexually harassed a 27-year-old woman early in the morning.
A University of Madras study linked rapid urban expansion, drainage gaps, and shrinking waterbodies to rising flood risks in Velachery and other Chennai hotspots.
Residents near the newly inaugurated Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station face a long detour because one entrance has remained closed since March.
Minister Vijay Balaji inspected pre-monsoon precautionary work on rainwater drainage systems in the Ambattur zone of Chennai Corporation.
Firefighters successfully rescued an eight-foot python that had crept into a factory near Avadi in the Thiruvallur district.
The district collector released the revised draft polling station list covering ten assembly constituencies in Thiruvallur.
Chennai Mayor Priya criticized the government after AI technology was used to generate defamatory videos of her and police failed to act on complaints.
Chennai is developing Fintech City, a dedicated 110-acre business district for banking and financial services on Mount Poonamallee Road in Nandambakkam.
Artificial intelligence is transforming flavor development in Chennai, helping food companies create and adapt regional products much faster.
Political buzz grew around actor Dhanush's potential political entry as Vijay's TVK party welcomed the move while stressing the need for full-time commitment.
Equinix India announced plans to expand its data center capacity in the country with a specific target of reaching 70 MW.
The Government of India opened applications for the IndiaAI Fellowship Programme, offering funding up to one lakh rupees for students.
